info.name: Tripora API
info.description: Tripora backend API — V1 (Auth + User Profile/Admin + Destination + Travel Guide + Trip Planner + Wishlist + Review + Blog + Notification + Report) + V2 (Provider + Property + Room + Room Inventory + Booking). Import together with tripora-api.postman_environment.json.

request.description: Creates a new User (role USER). Sets refreshToken as an HTTP-Only cookie. 409 if the email is already registered.
Sets refreshToken as an HTTP-Only cookie. 401 if email/password is wrong.
Reads refreshToken from the HTTP-Only cookie (Postman keeps cookies automatically after Login). Rotates the refresh token and returns a new accessToken. 401 if missing/expired/revoked.
Revokes the current refreshToken and clears the cookie.
Requires Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>. 401 if missing/expired token.
Yeu cau role ADMIN. Filter bang q (contains email/firstName/lastName). Khong tra passwordHash.

Yeu cau role ADMIN. status: ACTIVE | INACTIVE | BANNED. 400 neu tu doi status cua chinh minh. User bi BANNED/INACTIVE se khong the dang nhap (login tra 403) va refresh token bi thu hoi (refresh tra 401).
Public. Filter bằng q (contains name) / country. Trả { items, pagination }.
Public. 404 nếu không tồn tại/đã xoá.

Yeu cau role ADMIN. Khoa 1 Provider dang APPROVED (400 neu khong phai APPROVED). Chuyen status -> SUSPENDED, chan moi thao tac tu quan ly Property/Room/Room Inventory (dung lai check status===APPROVED co san, khong can sua gi them) va chan dang nhap vao Admin. `reason` tuy chon, dua vao Notification gui chu ho so.
Yeu cau role ADMIN. Mo khoa 1 Provider dang SUSPENDED (400 neu khong phai SUSPENDED), tra ve APPROVED. Tu dong gui Notification cho chu ho so.

Public. 404 neu khong ton tai hoac chua APPROVED.

request.description: Yeu cau dang nhap + co Provider profile APPROVED (403 neu khong). Trang thai ban dau PENDING, chua hien thi public toi khi Admin duyet. slug tu sinh + dedup tu name.
Chi chu so huu (Provider) moi duoc sua. 403 neu khong phai chu so huu.
Chi chu so huu moi duoc xoa. Soft delete (204 No Content).
Yeu cau role ADMIN. status: APPROVED hoac REJECTED. `reason` tuy chon, dua vao Notification gui cho chu so huu.
Public. Chi tra Room status ACTIVE, va chi khi Property da APPROVED (404 neu chua duyet).
Yeu cau dang nhap + so huu Property nay (qua Provider da APPROVED). Tra toan bo Room, bat ky status.
Yeu cau dang nhap + so huu Property (qua Provider da APPROVED, 403 neu khong). Trang thai mac dinh ACTIVE — hien thi public ngay neu Property da duoc duyet (Room khong can duyet rieng).
Chi chu so huu (qua Property -> Provider) moi duoc sua. Doi status sang INACTIVE de an tam thoi khoi public ma khong can xoa.
Chi chu so huu moi duoc xoa. Soft delete (204 No Content).
Public. Chi tra ket qua neu Room dang ACTIVE va Property cha da APPROVED (404 neu khong).
Yeu cau dang nhap + so huu Room nay. Tra du lieu bat ke Room/Property da duyet hay chua.

Yeu cau dang nhap + so huu Room (qua Property -> Provider da APPROVED, 403 neu khong). Upsert theo tung ngay trong khoang [startDate, endDate] (toi da 90 ngay/lan goi) — ngay da co san se cap nhat lai totalRooms/availableRooms/price, ngay chua co se tao moi. `price` bo trong se giu gia cu (khi update) hoac de trong (khi tao moi, Frontend se fallback ve basePrice cua Room). 400 neu totalRooms moi < so phong da booked cua ngay do.
Yeu cau role ADMIN. Xem toan bo Booking cua moi User, kem thong tin nguoi dat (email/ten). Filter theo status: CONFIRMED | CANCELLED.

Public, khong can dang nhap. Tra { available, nights, totalPrice, currency, unavailableDates[] } — dung o buoc 'Check Availability' truoc khi nhap Guest Information. checkOutDate la ngay tra phong, khong tinh vao so dem (VD 09-01 -> 09-03 la 2 dem: 09-01 va 09-02).

Yeu cau dang nhap (bat ky USER nao, khong can Provider). Tru availableRooms atomic tung dem trong 1 transaction (UPDATE ... WHERE available_rooms >= 1) — 409 neu het phong 1 trong cac ngay, 400 neu ngay do Provider chua mo ban ton kho hoac so guests vuot capacity cua Room. Booking luu snapshot propertyName/roomName/totalPrice tai thoi diem dat, khong bao gio join nguoc lay gia hien thi.

request.description: Yeu cau dang nhap + co ho so Provider da APPROVED (403 neu khong). Xem Booking cua tat ca Room thuoc cac Property minh so huu (khong phai Booking minh tu dat voi tu cach khach hang — dung /bookings/mine cho truong hop do).

query.description: Bo trong = tat ca. upcoming | completed | cancelled

request.description: Yeu cau dang nhap. Chi tra booking cua chinh minh. upcoming/completed tinh tu checkOutDate so voi hom nay (khong luu status rieng, tranh can cron) — status DB chi co CONFIRMED/CANCELLED.

Yeu cau dang nhap + la chu booking (403 neu khong). 400 neu booking da CANCELLED hoac checkInDate da toi/qua (khong huy duoc booking dang o/da o). Hoan tra availableRooms/bookedRooms atomic tung dem cung 1 transaction voi viec chuyen status -> CANCELLED.
